messages:
Alex: Quick idea — package-based capacity offers instead of single reserved pools. Customers pick a bundle (S, M, L) that includes baseline reserved GPUs + a flexible burst credit bucket. Goal: simpler procurement for mid-market and clearer upgrade path for SMBs.
Marta: Love the idea. How do we define pricing bands vs Dedicated?
Sam: Pricing Qs: are bundles monthly credits or committed hours? Billing wrt overage?
Alex: Plan is 3-month committed credits by default for S/M/L. Overage consumes burst credits at higher per-token rate. Convert-to-reserved button lets customers lock credits into a Dedicated contract (annual) with discount.
Jess: Launch gating — we should require: 1) telemetry on per-tenant tail latency with bundle enabled, 2) billing export for bundle usage, 3) UI for conversion + legal guardrails.
Kai: Metrics to track in pilot: conversion rate (bundle->reserved), average burst utilization, 99th p50/p95 latency delta vs baseline. Also churn delta for customers who overspend on burst.
Sam: Billing edge cases: prorating when switching bundles mid-billing-cycle; rollover policy for unused burst credits; refunds if latency SLO violated? Legal will push back on refunds.
Marta: For rollover, propose 30-day roll over for startup bundles, no rollover for discounted annual lock-ins. Keeps incentives to convert.
Alex: Agree. Also add an emergency protect mode: if a tenant exceeds burst credit by >200% in 24h, auto-block or throttle with notice and ops alert.
Jess: Ops playbook needed: escalation path when a high-value customer hits emergency protect. Include manual override and one-click temporary burst top-up in Console.
Kai: Small sample config we can A/B test (pilot):
```
bundle: small
commit_period: 3m
reserved_units: 2gpus
burst_credits: 100k_tokens
rollover: 30d
overage_price_multiplier: 2.5
```
Alex: Pilot customers: BetaCorp (mid-market), EduApp (PLG SMB), and FinPartner (enterprise but wants trial). BetaCorp wants predictable cost + soft burst.
Sam: For FinPartner, legal will insist on SLA credits. We should map SLA credit formula to burst exhaustion windows (e.g., 1% monthly credit if we miss 99th latency SLO > 3 occurrences).
Marta: Scope negotiation: MVP should not include annual contract conversion automation — manual sales-led conversion is fine. Focus MVP on UI for bundle selection, billing export, telemetry, and emergency protect.
Jess: Launch checklist (MVP):
- Console: bundle selection & usage panel
- Billing: export + prorate logic docs
- Runtime: throttle + emergency protect rule
- Observability: per-tenant burst usage + latency deltas
- Legal: T&Cs for rollover & refunds
- Pilot runbook + SRE oncall shift for first 2 weeks
Kai: Experiment ideas: randomize whether the Console shows “Convert to Reserved — save 20%” vs “Contact Sales” and measure click-through and conversion.
Sam: Data gating for GA: must have 90 days pilot data from at least 3 customers, <0.5% incidents caused by burst logic, and documented proration behavior.
Alex: Timeline proposal: 2-week spec + design, 6-week build (Console + Billing + Runtime), 4-week pilot, then iterate. Total ~12 weeks to pilot.
Marta: Risks: complexity in billing engine and legal churn risk. Mitigation: limit MVP to simple prorate rules, no refunds automatic.
Jess: Ops note — ensure rate limiting integration with existing per-tenant quotas; don't create a second independent limiter.
capacity-bot: [automated] Created tracking ticket: #CAP-4827 "Bundle offers MVP: console + billing + runtime" assigned to product.
Alex: Next steps: I'll write the spec doc and share in #product-design by EOD. Marta & Sam, can you draft billing proration and legal cliff notes?
Marta: On it, will post a short doc by tomorrow.
Sam: I'll prototype billing CSV examples and a sample invoice line item.
Jess: I'll draft the pilot runbook and required SLO dashboards.
Kai: I'll stub Dashboards and add the A/B experiment flags to tracking plan.
Alex: Great. Quick decision: no automatic refunds in MVP, rollover 30d for monthly bundles only, emergency protect throttle default ON. 👍
Marta: +1
Sam: +1
Jess: +1
Kai: +1
